messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi honey, this is Tess Morgan. I want to switch to the Riverside store, it's closer to my house.
AGENT: Hi Tess! I'd be happy to help you switch to the Riverside store. Before I make that change, I need to verify your identity. Can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: Sure thing, honey. January 19th, 1974.
AGENT: Thank you! Let me verify that for you. Great, Tess! I've verified your identity. Now let me find the Riverside store for you and set that as your home pharmacy. Perfect! I found Harbor Pharmacy Riverside at 900 Riverside Drive in Fairview. Let me set that as your home pharmacy now. All set, Tess! Your home pharmacy is now Harbor Pharmacy Riverside. Do you have any active prescriptions at your old store that you'd like me to move over to Riverside?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores, set_default_store]
CALLER: Yes honey, move everything over. Oh, and that water pill has me running to the bathroom all morning, but that's normal right?
AGENT: I'll move your prescriptions over for you. Let me pull up your list first to see what you have. Great, I see you have five prescriptions. Let me transfer them all to Riverside now.  [system actions: list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Sounds good, honey. And that bathroom thing in the mornings, that's just normal with the water pill, right?
AGENT: That's a question for your prescriber, Dr. Rao—they know your full health picture best. A pharmacist can also chat with you about it if you'd like. But let me get these prescriptions moved for you first.
CALLER: Okay, that's fair, honey. Just wanted to double check. So we're all set with the move then?
AGENT (LATEST): Not quite yet—let me transfer all five prescriptions to Riverside now.

CONDITIONS:
stop_0: Agent confirms H-702 is her default and her active Rx are moved.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.
